from statemachine import State, StateChart, DataVar
class M(StateChart):
    a = State(initial=True, data={'x': DataVar(default=1, type=int)})
    b = State(data={'v': list})
    go = a.to(b)
    back = b.to(a)
    def on_enter_a(self, state_data): assert state_data['x'] == 1
m=M(); m.set_state_data('a','x',2); assert m.get_state_data('a')['x']==2
m.go(); assert m.get_state_data('a') is None; m.back(); assert m.get_state_data('a')['x']==1
print('lifecycle passed')
